correctness.rationale: Conditional bridge means follow by exchangeability of integrable Lévy increments; each observed interior block has normalized integrated residual variance d³/12, and the unobserved terminal tail d³/3. Exact subset averaging yields the objective; all-delivered positive probability proves strict convexity. Perfect-delivery Lagrange multipliers give 2i/(2n+1). Strong convexity localizes rare-delivery minimizers at 2/3+O(p), then a uniform third-order expansion gives offsets (2i-n-1)/9 and sharp gain n(n²-1)p³/486. The actual standalone exact-rational verifier passed 102 supplementary checks for n≤6; finite checks do not certify the infinite family.

value.rationale: Fixed-budget exact-sample sensing with packet erasures is a motivated quadrature-design problem for both diffusive and jump signals. An all-budget uniqueness theorem and non-Gaussian universality yield a free-terminal 2/3 clustering law and sharp, strictly positive n(n²-1)/486 diversification gain. It supplies concrete location/robustness guidance, not merely a one-parameter textbook specialization; exact law is restricted to each fixed budget and to the stated loss/erasure model.
